summary: Validated cross-cutting company.currency (DOP) propagation for People Ops. Backend: GET /api/org-config returns company_currency='DOP' & company_timezone OK; POST /api/people-ops/employees/migrate-currency returns target_currency=DOP (idempotent OK). Frontend (Playwright): Overtime page renders DOP correctly — header '$125,000 Monthly Payroll' (no 'USD' code), Period Report 'Estimated Amount RD$7,263.16', Salary 'RD$75,000.00', Hourly 'RD$789.47', Est. Cost (Month) 'RD$14,606.91'. Payroll page renders DOP ('RD$153,828.21', 'RD$125,000.00', 'RD$79,029.63'). HOWEVER a CRITICAL regression breaks employee creation: POST /api/people-ops/employees is routed to migrate_employee_currency (returns {updated:0, target_currency:'DOP'}) instead of create_employee, making employee creation, the explicit-USD-override path, and the PUT currency persistence test impossible to verify end-to-end.

critical.issue: Route hijacked by migrate_employee_currency. In /app/backend/routers/people_ops.py line 1243-1245 the function migrate_employee_currency has TWO decorators: @people_ops_router.post('/employees') AND @people_ops_router.post('/employees/migrate-currency'). The first decorator registers it BEFORE create_employee, so FastAPI matches POST /employees to migrate_employee_currency and never reaches create_employee. Verified by inspecting router.routes (two POST /people-ops/employees registered, migrate first) and by live API: posting a full employee payload returns {'updated':0,'target_currency':'DOP'} instead of a created employee. Fix: delete the duplicate '@people_ops_router.post("/employees")' decorator on line 1243.

action_items: Remove the stray '@people_ops_router.post("/employees")' line above migrate_employee_currency in /app/backend/routers/people_ops.py (line 1243). Keep only '@people_ops_router.post("/employees/migrate-currency")'. Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_people_ops_currency.py — all 6 tests must pass (currently 3/6 pass).
critical_code_review_comments: people_ops.py routing bug: duplicate POST /employees decorator silently shadows create_employee. Consider adding a startup check or a unit test that asserts each (method,path) tuple is registered to exactly one endpoint.
useCurrencyFormatter.js falls back to 'USD' on companyCurrency null — works, but could surface a loading state to avoid a flash of USD before org-config loads.
EmployeeUpdate now includes currency — good — but ensure GET /employees response also surfaces the resolved currency consistently (already returns 'DOP' for existing emps).
people_ops.py is ~5,000 lines — way over the 700-line guideline. Split into employees.py, payroll.py, overtime.py, offboarding.py sub-routers.

rca of the issue: Copy-paste regression: migrate_employee_currency was added with two stacked decorators — the intended /employees/migrate-currency and an accidental /employees. Because FastAPI iterates routes in registration order and migrate_employee_currency is defined before create_employee, the migrate handler wins for POST /employees. Reproduction: POST /api/people-ops/employees with any valid EmployeeCreate body returns {'updated':0,'target_currency':'DOP'} (HTTP 200) instead of the created employee. Mitigation: delete line 1243. One-line fix.
